name: King Eoric
title: The Lion of Starlight
description: A tall, broad-shouldered monarch with silver-streaked black hair and piercing amber eyes. Known for his booming voice, judicious rulings, and the golden crown embossed with a rising sun.

lineage: Son of Queen Aveline the Just

notable_events.event: Defended the northern passes from the Frost Legion
Negotiated the Treaty of Silvermarsh with the Elven Court

inventory.name: Crown of Sunrise
inventory.description: A ceremonial crown said to bless the wearer with the sun’s favor.

inventory.name: Gilded Sword
inventory.description: A longsword with a sunburst guard, often carried in processions.
